Market today:
Chip sector weakness is deepening, pushing the Nasdaq-100 towards correction. AI spending is a mixed bag, hitting some big tech names while others gamble big. This is a tough environment for your concentrated tech/chip book.

Your holdings:
SOXL (-56.96%) and SPAL (-54.75%) are in deep trouble, both leveraged and well past their default stops. QQQ (-5.48%) and QQQI (-7.69%) are at or near their stops. Margin amplifies these drops significantly.

Watch:
Closely monitor the chip sector for further weakness and be ready to act on your stops for QQQ, SMH, SOXL, QQQI, and SPAL.

Bottom line:
Prioritize aggressive risk management on your leveraged and underperforming tech/chip positions.
plays: Trim SMH immediately; your stop at 540 is above the current price of 529.60, indicating a breach.
Aggressively trim SOXL and SPAL; both are leveraged, decaying, and far past their default stops with massive losses.
Consider a small hedge with SOXS (inverse semiconductors) given the sector weakness. Scanner entry 61.49-61.07, stop 60.33.
